verdict.rationale: Notte supports scripting deterministic automations and deploying them as serverless 'Functions'/API endpoints, and lets users generate workflow code via CLI then edit it, going beyond a single one-shot prompt (notte-docs-26, notte-docs-2, notte-docs-30, notte-gh-2). However there is no explicit documentation of workflow-level constructs like loops, conditionals, or parameterized templates. missing for 10: explicit docs on loop/conditional syntax in workflows, parameter binding across runs, independent confirmation of repeatable multi-step workflow composition.
